title: Usage-Based AI FP&A Toolkit
description: A free toolkit for planning usage-based cloud and AI products: an Excel model, a Python script and an LLM skill package that link usage to revenue, LLM cost, cloud cost, gross margin and a risk-adjusted ROI range. Companion to 'Financial Planning for Agentic & AI Systems: Managing Volatility in the Age of Autonomy' (California Management Review Insights, 2026). All example data is synthetic and illustrative.
